review.content_class_rationale: Opened the one-page PDF and its rendered page: the CARE case report reporting checklist, with topic, item number, item description and a Reported on Line column of line-number ranges and a ticked informed-consent box; it holds no patient-specific clinical values.
review.notes: Reporting checklist referenced in the Statement of Ethics; line numbers only, no clinical content.

limitations: Container metadata only; frames must be viewed separately

review.content_class_rationale: Sampled 19 frames at full resolution (5 s apart, 0 to 90 s) of the 90.7 s video and viewed them as 2 x 2 contact sheets: an operative microscope view of the eye with on-screen captions naming tube exposure, scarred conjunctiva, a small trephination, corneal button placed over the exposed tube, 10-0 nylon sutures, a conjunctival flap, flap secured with fibrin glue, and a final slit-lamp style frame captioned post op year 1 with the tube covered; a video-platform watermark appears in the corner.

ownership_evidence.quote: Revision surgery was performed 3 days after tube exposure was noted (video is attached as online suppl. material

review.notes: Operative video of the index patient revision surgery described in the Surgical Technique section; the video shows the steps the text describes and adds no clinical fact to the annotation. Burned-in captions and a platform watermark are overlaid; the post op year 1 caption agrees with the abstract and Fig. 2 caption (1-year) and differs from the 2-year follow-up in the body text.
limitations: Frames sampled every 5 s (19 frames from 0 to 90 s), viewed as 2 x 2 contact sheets at full frame resolution; audio and continuous motion and the frames between samples were not reviewed.
Machine draft: every review block must be completed by a reviewer who inspected the content.
